create_CaptionTextDropoutProcessor: create a CaptionTextDropoutProcessor with a dropout probability to randomly drop text captions during training
run_CaptionTextDropoutProcessor_forward: run the CaptionTextDropoutProcessor forward method on a string or list of string captions
create_CaptionEmbeddingDropoutProcessor: create a CaptionEmbeddingDropoutProcessor with a dropout probability to zero out caption embeddings during training
run_CaptionEmbeddingDropoutProcessor_for: run the CaptionEmbeddingDropoutProcessor forward method on a torch tensor of caption embeddings
test_CaptionTextDropoutProcessor: test the CaptionTextDropoutProcessor class with dropout_p set to zero to verify captions pass through unchanged
